claim_scope: Outcome-independent development qualification of whether the minimal target-state replay treatment merits a larger development batch. This is not a held-out, confirmatory, leaderboard, effect-size, or SOTA result.

selection_provenance.clarification: The recorded positions 9-12 refer to the pre-existing randomized order in experiments/schedules/envsolve_pro_v2_flash0731_dev16.json. The preregistration's source_file field names the associated identity selection rather than the ordering artifact. Exact case IDs, seeds, arm orders, and run IDs were unambiguous and matched the pre-existing schedule; no case changed after outcomes were observed.

arms.A-F: One continuous free Agent session with ordinary execution feedback and the shared minimal evaluator-integrity boundary.
arms.B-FCsR: The same mechanism plus repeatedly callable whole-program replay from the target initial state, with raw counterexamples returned to the same active session and final delivery restricted to a replay-passed program.

primary_fixed_replacement_analysis.interpretation: The one-discordant-pair table is descriptive and cannot estimate a stable effect. The B-only probatus pass used a first-pass replay and does not isolate replay-conditioned repair from stochastic trajectory variation.

sensitivity_excluding_operator_affected_.interpretation: The direction is unchanged, but three pairs remain too small for an effectiveness claim.

episodes.failure_summary: The delivered script created a uv virtual environment and then invoked its missing pip module. Construction residue had hidden the incomplete state transition.

episodes.mechanism_interpretation: First-replay certification, not feedback-conditioned repair. The B-only Official pass is treatment-level evidence but its causal path may be ordinary model variance.

Replay first exposed unavailable setuptools in build isolation and a missing required build_output directory; the next program passed the executable goal but still omitted build_output; the third materially changed program satisfied both and passed Official.

episodes.failure_summary: The program masked a failed PETSc/SLEPc installation with shell success coercion, so the fresh final environment lacked petsc4py and slepc4py.
The replacement active session exhausted 120 model requests without submitting a candidate, so target-state replay never entered the control loop.

mechanism_outcomes.interpretation: Target-state replay is executable and can repair a complete-program defect, but it cannot help before the Agent forms a candidate.

all_four_pairs.interpretation: There is no unconditional efficiency gain: the cellrank candidate-formation failure makes B slower and more token-intensive overall.

joint_success_cases_descriptive_only.interpretation: This selected-on-joint-success slice is descriptive and cannot support an efficiency effect claim.

operator_interruption.interpretation: The episode was interrupted by the researcher during its first clean replay. It is not a provider-infrastructure failure or an algorithmic terminal outcome and its resources are not included in treatment aggregates.

decision.action: Advance the unchanged minimal target-state replay treatment to the next fixed larger development batch while retaining A-F as the control.
decision.reason: B did not reduce paired success, produced one B-only Official pass, and importlib_metadata independently demonstrated fail-fail-pass complete-program repair.
limits: Do not attribute the probatus B-only pass specifically to replay-conditioned repair.
Do not claim an effectiveness or efficiency improvement from four development pairs.
Do not add case-specific rules, checkpoints, cross-case memory, or harder operation constraints before the larger fixed batch.
Report the cellrank-pair exclusion sensitivity in every summary of this batch.
